# lumos Provider

Lumos API (v1): Manage Lumos apps, entitlements, workflows, access policies and pre-approval rules through the Lumos V1 API. To upgrade from 0.x, follow the migration guide: https://registry.terraform.io/providers/teamlumos/lumos/latest/docs/guides/migrating-from-0x

## Example Usage

```terraform
terraform {
  required_providers {
    lumos = {
      source  = "teamlumos/lumos"
      version = "~> 1.0"
    }
  }
}

provider "lumos" {
  server_url = "..." # Optional
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Optional

- `http_bearer` (String, Sensitive) HTTP Bearer. Configurable via environment variable `LUMOS_ACCESS_TOKEN`.
- `server_url` (String) Server URL (defaults to https://api.lumos.com)
